thread:
clare: Draft up for the product launch blog (short form + tiny benchmark sidebar). Need legal quick-pass, design hero crop, and growth to confirm inbound routing for the webinar CTA. Target publish next week. Draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/q2-mini-draft (comments inline)

nina: reading now. For benchmarks, we should be explicit about the test environment. Suggest: 'Tests run on Dedicated N6x4, 16k context window, median of 5 runs.'

clare: added that exact line and a link to the perf workbook. Also added a 1-sentence methodology note at the bottom.

diego: legal quick-pass: avoid superlatives and comparative claims. Replace any "best" or "cheaper" wording with "lower unit cost observed in our tests" and include the methodology link. Also don't imply Hosted has SLAs.

clare: updated language to "lower unit cost observed in our tests (see methodology)" and removed any hosted SLA implications. Pushed new draft.

tom: design asks for hero: latency vs cost gradient, crop to 1200x630. I'll add a small screenshot showing the webinar CTA as a mock (CTA copy: "Save my seat").

ev an: growth routing: HubSpot list = "Webinar: Redwood Launch Q2", contact property first_touch_campaign=launch_q2_2024, hidden field campaign_code=launch_q2_2024. Owner rule: if company_revenue > 10000000 -> Enterprise AE queue, else -> SDR queue. Also make sure UTM tags are preserved through shortlink redirect.

ev an: final UTMs for paid promos: utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign=launch_q2_2024&utm_content=webinar_cta

clare: noted. I'll ensure the CTA shortlink appends UTMs and includes the hidden campaign_code. Changing CTA to "Save my seat" across hero and footer.

diego: quick content nit: in the routing paragraph, add a sentence clarifying fallback behavior: "When primary capacity is unavailable requests will route to compatible model variants or a lower-cost tier, depending on policy." Makes expectations clearer.

clare: added that sentence. Also softened any deterministic phrasing to "observed" and "targets" per legal.

publish-bot: preflight scheduled -> 2024-05-22T12:00:00Z. Automated checks: link validity, image size, utm on CTA, hubspot mapping, copy for legal flags.

tom: design ok with the crop and CTA microcopy. I'll upload the final PNG to Figma and attach the mock to the doc.

ev an: growth green on mappings and UTMs. :white_check_mark:

diego: legal quick-pass ok with revised phrasing. :ok_hand:

nina: product sign-off on technical claims. :thumbsup:

clare: locking the copy and scheduling publish for 2024-05-24 09:00 PDT. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
